name: Zsana (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Zsana: a crowned blue shield with a shepherd, a sheep, a sun and a crescent, within a wreath of white flowers.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Zsana arms with crown and wreath
